first: Well, a customer. Few make it this far with both legs intact.

first.speaker: Nico
first.text: I'm looking for a way home. Do you know how to leave the island?

first: Want to keep going? Everything has a price, traveler.
Relax, looking is free. But the island keeps count… and so do I. Take a look at my wares.
again: You're still standing. That's worth something.
I know things about the road, the forest and what lies beyond. But what's known has to be paid for, and I'm not offering discounts today.
If you bring gold, I've got wares. There's always something on offer.

final.speaker: Nico
final.text: I beat the Guardian. The green fragment is already shining in my compass.

final: A fragment… Cheap, compared to what's coming.
Tell me, traveler: have you never wondered why the island lets so few people leave?
Don't look at me like that. I only sell prices. Answers cost extra… and so do my wares.
